candidate_microdirections.question: Can observability/intervention overhead itself create false emergence signatures unless lesion/probe arms have footprint-matched placebo controls?
candidate_microdirections.falsifier: No material change in readouts under matched probe/placebo overhead across timing and load sweeps.

candidate_microdirections.question: Does the same declared semantic intervention remain the same causal operation across H1, H2 and H3 when physical/module representations change or fuse?
candidate_microdirections.falsifier: A broad intervention corpus shows observational and interventional commutation within tolerance without implementation-specific semantic lowering receipts.

candidate_microdirections.question: Can emergence metric shopping be controlled by preregistered hierarchical discovery and family-wise/null correction over many candidate assemblies and estimators?
candidate_microdirections.falsifier: Uncorrected and hierarchical procedures have indistinguishable false-discovery behavior under matched null ensembles.

candidate_microdirections.question: Do scheduler jitter and clock-domain remapping create false directed-flow or recurrence signatures unless semantic lag identity is preserved independently of wall-clock placement?
candidate_microdirections.falsifier: Lag/readout conclusions remain invariant under controlled scheduler and clock-domain perturbations.

recent_duplicate_check.novelty_boundary: Prior Emergenz spawn studied adaptation during lesion/rescue; this run studies whether a semantic intervention is causally equivalent after implementation/representation transformation.
